F14_W2.mechanism: move two next-packet high-vector loads between the two current-packet DFT3 tails
F14_W2.decision: retain benchmark-only micro-win; too small for independent production promotion

N5_tile_wave.mechanism: store each current-tile vector and immediately load the corresponding next-tile vector
N5_tile_wave.decision: hard stop: approximately one core cycle does not repay the peeled tail and 101-byte code growth

B3_block_wave.mechanism: preload four next-block B planes into dead ymm9..ymm12 during current R-squared finalization
B3_block_wave.decision: hard stop: real but sub-two-cycle effect with 184-byte code growth

overall_decision.status: wavefront scheduling locally measurable but exhausted below caller-significant scale
overall_decision.keep: F14-W2 as a benchmark-only same-size schedule oracle
reopen_only_if: a schedule removes instructions or a complete dependency layer
a new producer or consumer frees additional registers without code growth
the target ISA or microarchitecture changes
